import_help: Paste a XIVGear link to save a copy in this resource. Readers use the saved data; changes on XIVGear will not update this block automatically.
tabs_help: Include up to 20 sets. Multiple sets appear as tabs inside one block.
expanded_help: Guide layout with equipment, materia and food visible.
compact_help: Small armory card with item icons and optional details.
gcd_help: Base GCD uses a 2.5-second recast before job or ability haste. Attributes include the saved food, party bonus and sync settings.
invalid_url: Use an HTTPS link from xivgear.app or share.xivgear.app.
import_failed: The gearset could not be loaded. Check the link and try again shortly.
unsupported: This link has no usable gearsets, or contains unsupported custom items or data. Choose a shared set with in-game items.
